_meta.description: MisoStory Phase-1 entity catalogue for the 25 classic Maple Island maps. The required keys are mobs, npcs and per_map. Other keys (_meta, per_map[].map_name, per_map[].mob_spawns, per_map[].mob_spawn_total, per_map[].mobRate, per_map[].npcs[].fh, v22_deltas, the extra stat/sprite/era fields on mobs and npcs) are additions.
_meta.primary_source: maplestory.io GMS v8: https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/8/map/<id> (local copies in docs/research/raw/gms_v8/), https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/8/mob/<id> and https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/8/npc/<id> (local copies in docs/research/raw/entities/*_v8_*.json)
_meta.secondary_source: maplestory.io GMS v22, used for comparison and quest data only (v8 has no quest data; https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/8/quest/<id> returns 404): docs/research/raw/gms_v22/, docs/research/raw/entities/*_v22_*.json, docs/research/raw/entities/quests_v22/
_meta.sprites: docs/research/ref_sprites/<mob|npc>_<id>_<slug>.png = frame 0 of the 'stand' animation from https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/<v>/<mob|npc>/<id>/render/stand/0 (v8 for everything, including Ria 9010003, who exists in the v8 data but is placed only in the v22 Southperry map; v22 only for 9300018, 2004 and 2005, which do not exist in v8). Mobs also have <...>_move0.png (frame 0 of 'move'). PROPRIETARY reference images: do not copy or ship them.
_meta.counts_note: per_map[].mobs counts are spawn-point (life) entries in the map data, not how many mobs are alive at once. [memory] The server derives the live population from the map area and mobRate.
_meta.units: All coordinates and sprite sizes are MapleStory pixels; y increases downward. fh = footholdId from the map data.
_meta.warning: Do NOT use v62+ NPC renders for 2100/2101/2102: from v62 on they are maple-leaf costume variants, not the classic look. Do not use v83+ map data at all, because the map IDs were repurposed.

100100.name: Snail
100100.visual: DIFFERENT BASE DESIGN from Blue/Red Snail. Low, elongated slug body in pale lavender-white with a lavender-blue shaded underside/foot; the front end rises into a neck topped by a round white head with a single sleepy/closed eye drawn as a curved black line (reads like an eye-stalk head). A large dark teal-green spiral shell (teal base, lighter cyan-green highlights, dark spiral groove) sits on the rear and is taller than the head. Faces left in the frame. Smallest, flattest silhouette of the five mobs.

100101.name: Blue Snail
100101.visual: Chunky rounded cream/peach body (wide base tapering upward, like a blob or dumpling), with two large eyes on top under heavy tan/brown droopy half-closed lids (bored expression); white eyeballs, black pupils; a faint short mouth line on the front of the body. A royal/medium-blue spiral shell (darker blue spiral groove, light-blue highlight) sits on the back/right side and is roughly as tall as the body. Taller and chunkier than the 100100 Snail.

120100.name: Shroom
120100.visual: Small mushroom creature. Dome cap in red-orange with lighter peach/orange blotchy spots and a darker red-orange rim, overhanging a short tan/beige stem that is the face. Asymmetric angry face: one eye squinting under a furrowed brow, the other a large round white eye; small open mouth with red inside. Dark olive-brown lump at the base (feet/ground shadow). Squat; the cap is nearly as wide as the frame.
120100.name_note: String data names it 'Shroom' in v8, v22, v40, v62, v83 and v95. The v22 quest 1016 text calls it 'Spore'.

130101.name: Red Snail
130101.visual: Same sprite as Blue Snail (100101) with only the shell recoloured: crimson/magenta-red shell with a darker red spiral groove (251-pixel difference vs Blue Snail; everything else identical: cream body, two lidded eyes on top).

1210102.name: Orange Mushroom
1210102.visual: Largest island mob. Wide orange cap (orange gradient, darker orange rim) with large yellow spots, tilted slightly to one side; a grey-brown gill ring is visible under the cap. Body is a soft round white/cream dumpling shape, wider than tall, with two small black dot eyes and a small ':3'-style smiling mouth; no visible arms or legs. The cap is wider than the body.

9300018.name: Tutorial Jr. Sentinel
9300018.era: v22 only, not placed in v8 maps
9300018.visual: v22-only tutorial mob. A round beige stone ball with a black horizontal band and a gold gem in the centre. The sprite also bakes in tutorial UI above the stone (a grey 'Ctrl' keycap graphic with a yellow outline and an orange down-arrow). Not present in the v8 maps.

2000.name: Roger
2000.role: Tutorial instructor in Mushroom Town (10000). v8 dialogue covers the inventory, picking up, using and dropping items, potions/HP, and 'You want to go travel now? Then come talk to me'. Peter's older brother (per Peter's dialogue). No quests in the v22 API data.
2000.visual: Long dark navy/black hair in a low ponytail draped over the right shoulder; heavy-lidded, bored eyes. Red tracksuit-style uniform: a row of white buttons/marks across the chest, a gold shoulder emblem on the right shoulder, a yellow stripe down the trouser leg, white gloves, grey-white shoes.

2001.name: Sen
2001.role: Hungry child in Mushroom Town Townstreet (20001). v8 dialogue: 'I'm... so ... hungry!'. [v22 data] Completes quest 1003 and starts 1004.
2001.visual: Small child: messy golden-orange hair, teal eyes, rosy cheeks, one finger raised to the mouth (hungry pose); brown/khaki tunic, orange boots.

2002.name: Peter
2002.role: Tutorial instructor at the East Entrance to Mushroom Town (30000). v8 dialogue: 'This is the exit to the Mushroom Town', 'If you want to move on to the next stage, talk to me', warns about monsters. Brother of Roger and Robin.
2002.visual: Same outfit design as Roger (2000) but in royal blue: blue uniform with gold shoulder emblem, yellow trouser stripe, white gloves. Shoulder-length ash-brown/taupe hair, same heavy-lidded expression. Pixel-identical to Robin (2003) in the v8 render.

2003.name: Robin
2003.role: Tutorial instructor in Snail Hunting Ground I (40000). v8 dialogue gives combat hints (left Ctrl to attack, Z to pick up, party up), names Mushroom Town, Southperry and Amherst, and says 'try heading up northeast'. Younger brother of Roger and Peter.
2003.visual: Pixel-identical to Peter (2002) in the v8 render: blue uniform with gold shoulder emblem, yellow trouser stripe, white gloves; shoulder-length ash-brown/taupe hair.

2004.name: Todd
2004.role: v22 only: tutorial NPC at the East Entrance to Mushroom Town (30000). [v22 data] Quest 1018 'Todd's How-to-Hunt' (kill 1 Tutorial Jr. Sentinel 9300018, then talk to Peter).
2004.era: v22 only, not placed in v8 maps
2004.visual: v22 only. NPC data has link=2003, so it uses Robin's sprite; the render is pixel-identical to Robin/Peter (blue uniform, ash-brown hair).

2005.name: Sam
2005.role: v22 only: tutorial NPC in Snail Hunting Ground I (40000). [v22 data] Quest 1019 'Sam's Suggestion' (hunt 10 Snails, then meet Mai).
2005.era: v22 only, not placed in v8 maps
2005.visual: v22 only. NPC data has link=2003, so it uses Robin's sprite; the render is pixel-identical to Robin/Peter (blue uniform, ash-brown hair).

2100.name: Sera
2100.role: Mushroom Town resident (map 0), Heena's sister, hanging laundry. v8 dialogue: tutorial hints (press Up to climb ladders/ropes, double-click to talk). [v22 data] Completes quest 1000 and starts 1001 (item 4031003 'Sera's Mirror'); the v22 quest text calls her 'Sarah'.
2100.visual: Long wavy honey-blonde/olive-gold hair; light-blue apron or bib over a brown dress, hands together at the chest. The frame is cut off around the waist, so the lower body is not visible. Pixel-identical to Maria (2103) in v8.

2101.name: Heena
2101.role: Mushroom Town resident (map 0). v8 dialogue: tutorial hints (jump with left Alt, move with the arrow keys) and 'Arrghh, my beautiful skin...' (the v22 quest text explains this as worry about sunlight irritating her face). [v22 data] Starts quest 1000 'Borrowing Sarah's Mirror' and completes 1001 'Bringing a Mirror to Heena'.
2101.visual: Brown spiky/feathered hair with a pink headband; large dark eye, orange blush marks; both hands clasped at the chin. White top, with a navy-blue garment visible at the bottom edge. The 56x55 frame shows only head and upper body, so the pose is not fully visible. Pixel-identical to Rain (12101).

2102.name: Nina
2102.role: Mushroom Town resident (20000), Sen's sister. v8 dialogue: wondering what to make for dinner. [v22 data] Starts quest 1003 'What Sen wants to eat' and completes 1004 'Returning to Nina'.
2102.visual: Bunny costume: pink-and-white rabbit-ear headband, spiky dark-blue hair, blue eyes, pink strapless leotard, pink gloves, dark olive/brown tights, pink heels. Pixel-identical to Yoona (20100) in v8.

2103.name: Maria
2103.role: Person at A Split Road (50000) who wants a letter delivered. v8 dialogue: 'I need to get this letter sent...'. [v22 data] Starts quest 1005 'Letter for Lucas' (item 4031000 Maria's Letter) and completes 1006 'Lucas' Reply'.
2103.visual: Pixel-identical to Sera (2100) in v8: long wavy honey-blonde hair, light-blue apron over a brown dress; the frame is cut off around the waist.

10000.name: Pio
10000.role: Handyman in Amherst. v8 dialogue: 'I can handle machinery really well', is hungry, takes a break from work. [v22 data] Quest 1008 'Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods' (break scrap boxes in the village).
10000.visual: Stocky, tan-skinned handyman with a pale blond buzz cut and an orange-and-white cap worn tilted; eyes squeezed shut, lips pursed (straining). White T-shirt, light-blue denim overalls; carries a red-orange toolbox and a grey wrench.

11000.name: Sid
11000.role: Shopkeeper. Sourced facts: he stands in the map named 'Amherst Weapon Store' (1010001), and his v8 dialogue says 'On sale! Really CHEAP!'. The inventory is not available from the API.
11000.visual: Big, hulking man with olive/tan skin, a blond flat-top, black sunglasses and a frown; blue uniform (same family as Roger/Pan) with yellow shoulder and trouser stripes; hunched, fists held low; grey shoes.

11100.name: Lucy
11100.role: Shopkeeper. Sourced facts: she stands in the map named 'Amherst Department Store' (1010003), and her v8 dialogue says 'You definitely need potions to travel' and 'cheap goods'. [proposal] She probably sells potions and consumables. The inventory is not available from the API.
11100.visual: Girl with big curly brown hair and large green eyes; orange-brown pinafore/jumper dress over a light-blue blouse, hands on hips, brown shoes.

12000.name: Lucas
12000.role: Chief/elder of Amherst. v8 dialogue: distrusts strangers, worried about the town's peace, asks you to deal with monsters around town. [v22 data] Completes quest 1005 and starts 1006 'Lucas' Reply' (item 4031001 Lucas' Letter).
12000.visual: Elderly village chief: swept-back sandy-blond hair and a full beard, stern face; long white/ivory robe with gold hem trim and a gold belt, a purple stole over one shoulder fastened with a round gold clasp; wooden cane in hand.

12100.name: Mai
12100.role: Fighter in Amherst. v8 dialogue: 'Is there anyone that can satisfy my desire to fight...?'. [v22 data] Quests 1016 'Mai's Training' (hunt 10 each of Snail, Blue Snail and 120100; the quest text calls 120100 'Spore') and 1017 'Mai's Final Training' (10 Orange Mushrooms). In the v22 maps she stands at A Split Road (50000) instead of Amherst.
12100.visual: Young woman with brown high twin pigtails tied with red ribbons, pink/magenta eyes; red sleeveless qipao/cheongsam with a side slit, yellow sash, gold bracelet; holds a large curved broadsword (dao-like) with a gold guard, blade pointing down; red shoes.

12101.name: Rain
12101.role: Amherst tutorial helper. v8 dialogue: jump and movement hints, the same lines as Heena. [v22 data] Gives the 'Rain's Maple Quiz 1-7' quests (1009-1015), but the v8 dialogue has no quiz lines.
12101.visual: Pixel-identical to Heena (2101) in v8: brown spiky hair with a pink headband, hands clasped at the chin; the frame shows only the upper body.

20001.name: Bari
20001.role: Southperry sailor/dock worker; flavour only. v8 dialogue: 'Working hard there~', 'Salute~'.
20001.visual: Older sailor: white sailor cap, short grey hair, tan skin, sleepy-lidded eyes; navy sailor shirt, a large coil of olive/brown rope over the right shoulder, white trousers, brown shoes.

20002.name: Biggs
20002.role: Southperry sailor who is vain about his looks and wants to captain the big ship one day (v8 dialogue). [v22 data] Quest 1007 'Bigg's Collection of Items' asks for 30 Blue Snail Shells (4000000) and 10 Orange Mushroom Caps (4000001).
20002.visual: Young sailor: white sailor cap with a blue band, grey swept hair, scowling/arrogant face; navy sailor top with white stripes and a light-blue neckerchief, white trousers, brown shoes, hands on hips.

20100.name: Yoona
20100.role: Southperry resident; flavour only. v8 dialogue: 'Whoa, what are you looking at?!?!'.
20100.visual: Pixel-identical to Nina (2102) in v8: bunny-ear headband, spiky dark-blue hair, pink leotard and gloves, dark tights, pink heels.

21000.name: Pan
21000.role: Shopkeeper. Sourced facts: he stands in the map named 'Southperry Armor Store' (60001), and his v8 dialogue says 'I've got some goods here for sale!!'. The shop inventory is server-side and not in the API, and isShop is false for every NPC, so that flag cannot be used.
21000.visual: Short, chubby man with short brown hair, green-tinted sunglasses and a smug face; blue uniform in the same style as Roger/Peter (silver buttons, yellow shoulder patch, yellow trouser stripe), grey shoes.

22000.name: Shanks
22000.role: Ship captain at Southperry. v8 dialogue: 'I am the captain', 'I'll take you anywhere you want'. [memory] Sails players one way from Maple Island to Lith Harbor on Victoria Island for a mesos fee. Neither the destination nor the fare is in the API data.
22000.visual: Ship captain: large royal-blue wide-brim hat with a white feather plume on one side, blonde hair, blue eyes; blue long coat with gold trim and gold/orange square cuff panels, light shirt with dark-red detail at the chest. Holds a small gold-and-brown object in one hand (not identified from the sprite).

9000000.name: Paul
9000000.role: Event NPC in Southperry. v8 dialogue: 'Where's my brother...?', 'I need to get to where the event takes place...'. [memory] Used to warp players to GM-run events.
9000000.visual: Boy in a yellow cap worn backwards with a red brim, dark hair; white T-shirt with red shoulder straps (backpack), blue jeans with a yellow side stripe, red-and-white sneakers; holds a skateboard (pale deck, blue wheels) upright at his side.

9010000.name: Maple Administrator
9010000.role: Maple Administrator (official/GM presence) in Southperry. v8 dialogue: greetings and an anti-hacking-tools reminder. [v22 data] Gives the seasonal quest 8700 'Easter : Easter Basket' (level 8+).
9010000.visual: Woman in a white newsboy cap with a large blue 'W' logo, short black hair, white skirt suit, white shoes; carries a black briefcase with a white 'W' logo.

9010001.name: Tia
9010001.role: Event/greeter NPC in Southperry. v8 dialogue: 'Hey all!', 'Hope you all have a wonderful day today'. Replaced by Ria (9010003) in the v22 map.
9010001.visual: Girl with long auburn/red-brown hair and a small silver tiara, big blue eyes; pink jacket over a light top, blue flared jeans with pink bows at the hems, pink shoes; holds three star-patterned balloons (yellow, pink, cyan) on strings, which fill the top half of the 74x113 frame.

9010003.name: Ria
9010003.role: v22 only: replaces Tia in Southperry with the same dialogue. Not placed in any v8 map.
9010003.era: present in v8 NPC data but placed only in the v22 map (Southperry); not placed in v8 maps
9010003.visual: Recolour of Tia (9010001): long dark-blue hair, purple jacket, black trousers with purple bows, balloons in cyan/pink/yellow. v22 only (replaces Tia in Southperry).
